# Slack Modal — progress

Terse one-line per builder. Updated continuously during orchestration. Format: `[STATUS] phase / builder — short description (commit sha when complete)`.

## Phase 1 (7 parallel builders)

- [DONE] Phase 1 / Builder 5 — Project modal view builder (create + edit) with retainer-checkbox conditional + hint render. Single `src/lib/slack/modals/project.ts` builder per pre-plan v7 §B6 collapses Modal 2 (Project) and Modal 3 (Retainer) into one view via the `retainerMode` flag. Header swaps across all 4 mode×retainerMode combos verified. `retainerMode=false` renders engagement type radio (project / break-fix), parent retainer external_select, and the hint render stack (multi-match section block above baseline context block above picker) per §A3. `retainerMode=true` swaps engagement type to a read-only context block, removes the parent picker, suppresses BOTH hints regardless of caller input, and surfaces contractStart + contractEnd datepickers. All date inputs are `datepicker` (no free-text per §B5). `is_retainer_block` carries `dispatch_action: true` so the checkbox toggle fires `block_actions`. New helper `buildEphemeralRetainerToggle(payload)` returns a `response_action: "update"` payload with the opposite `retainerMode`, harvesting user-typed values from `state.values` (project name, dates, status, category, owner, resources rows, notes, engagement type radio, parent retainer pick) so they round-trip through `currentValues` and stay visible after re-render. 59 tests pass; lint zero errors. Source-level grep guard asserts no em-dashes / en-dashes / `\bL[12]\b` tokens in `project.ts`. Commit sha: <pending>.
